text:
Clara: OrbitAI reached out about onboarding Orbit-6B. they want an embargoed on-prem release for government customers and a special distribution clause.
Diego: embargoed? need to clarify dates and who controls the embargo. also ask if they require co-signed NDA for the embargo window.
Anya: license check first. do we have a CLA or license text? if theyre restricting release to gov customers, that could affect redistribution policy.
Clara: pasted their summary: "Orbit-6B available under Orbit Research License v0.9: distribution allowed to certified partners and governmental entities only; no public redistribution. embargo until 2026-05-15 for commercial announcements."
Leo: Ops note  if it's on-prem only and no downloads, we can support via Private deployments. but partner wants KMS/HSM integration to keep keys with them for decryption.
Tom: hosting encrypted artifacts + HSM key escrow is operationally heavy. we need a legal agreement and key custody SLA. does Orbit want us to hold artifacts or they ship appliances?
Clara: they prefer us to host encrypted checkpoints on our private registry and integrate with their HSM via remote attestation. only certified gov customers would have the decryption key.
Anya: that wording is effectively a redistribution to government customers. we need a tailored EULA clause limiting recipients, audit rights, and prohibiting onward redistribution. also need contributor list and dataset manifest for compliance.
Diego: export control red flag: gov customers + embargoed release = check ECCN & specific country restrictions. request full origin-of-contributors and any third-party licensed components.
Leo: security ops: remote HSM integration requires a threat model review. also request signed supply-chain SBOM and pentest report; FedRAMP considerations if customers are US gov.
Clara: Orbit is also asking for a joint technical whitepaper and a controlled press quote after embargo lifts. marketing requires a security and legal sign-off 2 weeks before lift.
Tom: also confirm billing: do we bill as Private deployment seats or per-token inference? gov customers often require separate billing flows and PO terms. Product needs to weigh in.
Anya: I'll draft a short EULA addendum: restrict distribution to certified government accounts, require audit logs for each key release, prohibit third-party sublicensing, and include indemnity for export violations.
Diego: I'll prepare an export checklist and request ECCN + country-of-origin + contributor residency. need to know if any training data came from restricted sources.
Leo: ops action: evaluate HSM integration complexity and estimate 5-7 days for prototype hooks after legal signs off. will also list infra isolation needs.
Clara: action items: Clara to request Orbit's full license, contributor list, SBOM, ECCN, and their HSM spec. Anya drafts EULA addendum. Diego compiles export questions. Leo scopes infra. reconvene next Thu.
legal-bot: reminder: open PART-1012 and upload license + SBOM + ECCN: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-1012
Clara: I'll open PART-1012 and cc Orbit. thanks team.
